title: Audit Existing README and Project Files
description: Review the current README.md, package.json, and project structure to gather accurate information for documentation.
details: Analyze the existing README.md to identify missing or outdated sections. Cross-reference with package.json for scripts, dependencies, and project metadata. Examine the directory structure and key files (e.g., app/, components/, public/, .env.example) to ensure all relevant features and setup steps are documented. Note any environment variables or configuration requirements.
test_strategy: Ensure all information gathered is up-to-date and accurately reflects the current state of the codebase. Validate findings by comparing with actual project files.

title: Draft Enhanced README Structure and Content
description: Create a comprehensive outline and draft content for the improved README.md, covering all required sections.
details: Structure the README with clear sections: Title, Badges, Project Overview, Features, Tech Stack, Getting Started, Available Scripts, Folder Structure, Environment Variables, Deployment, Contributing, and License. Write concise, developer-friendly content for each section. Prepare placeholders for badges and visual aids (screenshots/GIFs).
test_strategy: Review the draft for completeness, clarity, and logical flow. Ensure all required sections are present and easy to follow.

title: Update and Format README.md
description: Implement the drafted content in the README.md file, ensuring proper Markdown formatting and inclusion of all sections.
details: Replace or update the existing README.md with the new content. Use semantic Markdown for headings, lists, and code blocks. Add badges (e.g., build status, license) using shields.io. Insert links to official documentation for major technologies. Include instructions for setup, running, testing, and deployment. Add folder structure diagrams or code blocks as needed.
test_strategy: Preview the README in a Markdown viewer to verify formatting, link correctness, and visual clarity. Check for broken links or formatting issues.

title: Add Visual Aids and Example Files
description: Enhance the README with screenshots, GIFs, and example files to improve clarity and onboarding.
details: Capture and embed at least one screenshot or GIF demonstrating the dashboard UI. If not present, create a .env.example file and reference it in the README. Ensure all visual aids are optimized for web and stored in the public/ or assets/ directory. Update README links to these assets.
test_strategy: Verify that all images and files are correctly referenced and display as intended in the rendered README. Ensure .env.example matches required environment variables.

title: Validate README Usability and Accuracy
description: Test the updated README by following its instructions from scratch to ensure a smooth onboarding experience.
details: Simulate a new developer onboarding by cloning the repo, installing dependencies, setting up environment variables, and running the app using only the README instructions. Note any ambiguities or missing steps and revise the README as needed. Optionally, request feedback from another developer.
test_strategy: Successfully complete project setup and launch using only the README. Address any issues found during the process.
